terminology.affectedFamily: A semantic family containing at least one source file with a replay raster difference above the recorded threshold or a source-admission refusal.
terminology.fullyRefusedFamily: Every source file assigned to the semantic family was refused by source admission.
terminology.partiallyAvailableFamily: The semantic family has at least one refused source file and at least one admitted source file.
terminology.qualificationBoundary: Affected and flagged are prioritization terms. They do not prove that generation is blocked, that an admitted donor is unusable, or that a family fails visual qualification.

accounting.affectedFamilyPartition: 95 fully refused + 190 partially available with refusals + 415 affected with no refusals = 700 affected families.
accounting.availability: 605 of 700 affected families retain at least one admitted source file. Admission establishes source compatibility under the current gate; it does not establish generated output quality.
accounting.rasterDifferenceBoundary: The 162 families where every source file exceeds the replay threshold are flagged for replay investigation. This does not by itself establish donor or generation failure.

scope: Additive interpretation of the immutable v1 accounting receipt. No source admission, generation, remediation, or visual qualification decision is changed or closed.
